name: io.github.aarondpn/redmine-mcp
title: Redmine
description: Work with Redmine issues, projects, time entries, wiki pages and more. Read-only by default.

environmentVariables.name: REDMINE_SERVER
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Redmine instance, e.g. https://redmine.example.com

environmentVariables.name: REDMINE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Redmine API key (My account -> API access key)

environmentVariables.name: REDMINE_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to also register create/update/delete tools
